title: DispatchRequestV1
description: THE single source of truth for the work-OUT envelope a customer/sibling project posts to the mesh authority to request dispatch of a unit of work. Outbound counterpart to capture-envelope.schema.json (inbound). The customer declares WHAT work it wants in project-relative, capability terms; the AUTHORITY alone resolves routing (class->tier->steerer workflow, claim/dispatch mode, concrete model, host). additionalProperties:false makes the strip-list structurally enforceable: a customer cannot smuggle a mesh-internal routing primitive (counsel_class, steerer_workflow_id, dispatch_mode, claim_mode), a concrete model name (requested_model), a monorepo workspace shape (affected_packages/workspaces -> use the opaque payload key), a roster literal (project_hint/source_system:'sitelayer' -> use the opaque project_key), or a callback field (use callback-claim.schema.json) — any such field is a validation failure, not a silent pass-through. The TypeScript interface in src/dispatch-request.ts mirrors this schema field-for-field (a contract test enforces sync).

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version. The single declared version all producers emit; bumped only on a breaking change.

request_id.description: Producer-minted idempotent request id (UUID/ULID) echoed on the callback for result->request correlation. Distinct from idempotency_key (server-side de-dupe).

project_key.description: OPAQUE stable project key the authority resolves to a registered integration (data-driven via projects.url_patterns). NOT a closed-roster literal and NOT a 'sitelayer' literal. The single required routing field.

intent.description: What the customer wants done, in its own domain vocabulary (e.g. 'daily_sync', 'generate_puzzles', 'render_batch'). The authority maps (project_key, intent) -> routing; it does not constrain the customer's task taxonomy.

task_kind.description: Optional finer-grained kind within intent (e.g. intent='render_batch', task_kind='thumbnails'). Advisory.

subject.description: What the work is about — a project-relative pointer mesh echoes back on the callback. Opaque to mesh.

body.description: Free-form human-readable body / instructions for the work.

priority.description: Advisory urgency band; the authority maps it onto its own tiers. OPEN string so a producer can add a band; the authority clamps unknowns. Does NOT name a mesh queue.

requested_capability.description: The CAPABILITY the work needs (e.g. 'reasoning', 'codegen') — NOT a concrete model. The authority resolves capability -> tier -> model. OPEN string by design.

payload.description: Typed-OPEN, opaque structured work inputs. Replaces the execution_context smuggle bag. Mesh passes it through to the resolved worker; it does not route on its contents. Monorepo-shaped data (workspaces / affected_packages) goes here as opaque keys if at all.

created_by.description: Who/what on the customer side authored the request (user id, service name, cron identity). Advisory provenance; not a routing key.

idempotency_key.description: Server-side de-dupe key. Two requests with the same idempotency_key for the same project_key MUST collapse to one accepted dispatch.
